tasks.description: 1.1 Pin original allocator/CRT/OS contracts and all six accepted allocation boundaries; trace unchanged retained state to unexecuted lock entry, independently verify whole memory/CPU and missing debug-chain dependencies; add source/provenance corruption tests and documentation, then validate immutable reports.

2.1 Implement a bounded owned headless Win32 heap/file helper and explicitly separate fresh-input fixtures; run original x86 allocation/debug headers/list/accounting, concurrent unlink/free and complete source file-loader/read/free, independently replay full instructions/writes/memory/CPU and actual API ownership/cleanup; add corruption/ownership tests and docs, and run affected regressions.

3.1 Run strict specs and full previous evidence/save/checkpoint/resource preservation; update master progress with the unresolved retained CRT gap, commit locally, and archive this completed finite change with exact raw/index/HEAD and archive hashes.

context:
本项目为 Cross Hermit 原版逆向与 Godot 重制工作区，两者的完成状态分开报告。
逆向总范围、完成标准、2026-11-20目标及待完成里程碑以
openspec/specs/reverse-engineering/completion/spec.md 为准。
add-fifth-week-school-planning 已于2026-10-20归档，是历史记录，不再追加任务。
其423–428未完成计划已迁入总规格R1–R6，不得当作已完成研究。
每次继续推进先接续对应的有效change；没有对应change时才为下一个有限功能里程碑创建change。
不为每次对话、每条消息或每个接口新建change，不将所有余下工作堆入一个持续扩张的change。
完成的规格同步到总spec后归档对应change；历史原始证据、原存档及私有检查点保持不变。
完成连贯工作单元后本地Git提交，不push。
